tasks.title: Implement Null bag aspect suppression in ChemistryEngine

For spanning reagents, only cells physically inside the Null bag are suppressed -- other cells of the same reagent in non-Null bags retain their aspects. (3) Integrate into all three evaluation tiers. tasks.title: Normalize Stable buffering pattern across all ChemistryEngine tiers
tasks.description: ChemistryEngine has inconsistent Stable buffering: Adjacent and SameBag tiers use a skip pattern (if stableBuffer > rule.Threshold, continue -- skips the entire reaction check, doesn't raise the threshold), while WholeInventory uses the correct additive pattern (effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer). The skip pattern is wrong: Stable should raise the effective threshold, not act as a binary skip. Example: if threshold=2, stableBuffer=1, count=3, the skip pattern would NOT skip (1 < 2) and reaction fires at count=3 vs threshold=2. The additive pattern correctly makes effectiveThreshold=3, so count=3 would NOT fire. Fix: Normalize all three tiers to use effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer, then compare the computed count/magnitude against effectiveThreshold. Update unit tests to verify boundary behavior: stableBuffer raises threshold by exact magnitude, stableBuffer=0 has no effect, stableBuffer equal to count prevents reaction.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- all existing Stable tests still pass, new boundary tests pass, consistent behavior across tiers

tasks.description: Add Gravity bag placement constraint to the Core layer. 'Bottom' means the highest row index in the bag's shape matrix (row 0 is top, max row is bottom). A reagent cell at position (col, row) is supported if: (a) row is the maximum occupied row in the bag's shape for that column, OR (b) another reagent cell exists at (col, row+1) in the same bag. Implementation: (1) BagPropertyType.Gravity already exists. Bag stores its property via BagDefinition. (2) Add placement validation: when placing a reagent in a Gravity bag, check that every cell of the reagent is supported per the rule above. (4) Update PuzzleGenerator.BuildMetaGridWithBags (line ~318) to sometimes create Gravity bags when AllowSpecialBags is true -- use the seeded RNG to decide. (5) Heavy aspect interaction (must be at absolute bottom) is deferred to task B.3 -- this task only validates general support constraint. tasks.title: Implement Volatile net-hot calculation
tasks.description: Replace the current simple Hot+Volatile pair-trigger explosion with the net-hot system from docs/chemistry-system.md. The current Explosion rule in ReactionRuleDatabase treats it as a two-aspect pair (triggerAspects: [hot, volatile], Adjacent). The new system works differently: iterate each Volatile cell, compute net_hot = sum(Hot magnitudes of cardinal neighbors) - sum(Cold magnitudes of cardinal neighbors). If net_hot > effective_threshold (base 0 + stable_buffer), trigger Explosion. This makes Cold a strategic heat shield near Volatile. Implementation: (1) Change the Explosion rule to be a single-trigger rule (triggerAspects: [volatile] only). You may need to add a new RuleEvaluationType or special-case Volatile evaluation in EvaluateAdjacentRule. (2) For each placed reagent's Volatile cells, get cardinal neighbor cells, sum Hot magnitudes, subtract Cold magnitudes to get net_hot. (3) If net_hot > 0 + stableBuffer, trigger Explosion with affected cells being the Volatile cell and contributing Hot cells. (4) Null-suppressed cells (from R-3) should contribute 0 magnitude. (5) Update or replace existing Explosion tests. Add new tests: Volatile with Hot neighbor (explodes), Volatile with Hot+Cold balanced (net_hot=0, safe), Volatile with more Hot than Cold (explodes), Cold as heat shield (1 Hot + 1 Cold adjacent = safe), Volatile with no Hot neighbors (safe), Stable buffer raises effective threshold.
